    The 2026 Masters projected cut line is 4-over par (+4) as of Friday afternoon, according to DataGolf projections. The field is cut to the top 50 players and ties, with 4-over firmly established as the expected final number to survive for the weekend. 
    • Current Standing: The cut moved to +4 on Friday as conditions remained challenging.
    • Notable Players in Danger: Several big names faced the potential of missing the cut at +4 or higher, including Bryson DeChambeau and others struggling with the course.
    • Rule: The Masters takes the lowest 50 scores and ties, a rule change that took effect in 2020. 
    This information is based on data as of April 10, 2026.
